specification.problem: Estimate the ground-state energy E_0(R) of the 2-qubit reduced STO-3G HeH+ Hamiltonian at a chosen bond distance R by iterative (Kitaev-style) phase estimation using one reused ancilla and two system qubits, then compare to exact diagonalization of the 4x4 matrix.
specification.reconstruction_scope: One bond distance with explicit symbolic coefficients g0..g5 (to be supplied classically per R), 3 qubits total, m-bit iterative PEA with exact compilation of controlled-U^(2^k). Outside scope: computing the molecular integrals, the NV-center hardware, pulse-level control, error analysis behind the 1e-14 Hartree figure, and the full dissociation scan beyond looping over R.

symbols.meaning: Real coefficients of the reduced Hamiltonian at distance R, from classical integrals plus qubit mapping
Evolution time, chosen so that t*(E-E_ref) lies in a window of width less than 2\pi
Energy offset (shift) used to avoid phase wrapping
Measured ancilla bit for power 2^{k-1} (b_1 is most significant)
Feedback rotation angle in round k

equations.label: Reduced Hamiltonian
equations.description: Two-qubit form of the minimal-basis HeH+ electronic Hamiltonian after symmetry reduction
equations.justification: Known structure for minimal-basis 2-qubit molecular Hamiltonians; the abstract names only the minimal basis HeH+. The coefficients depend on R and the mapping and are not given.
assumptions: STO-3G, 2 spatial orbitals, reduced to 2 qubits by symmetry
g_i supplied classically for each R

equations.label: Block structure and exact evolution
equations.description: The XX and YY terms act in the odd-parity subspace {|01>,|10>}; XX+YY couples these with amplitude g4+g5 and annihilates |00>,|11>. U=e^{-iHt} is diagonal phases on |00>,|11> and a 2x2 rotation with phase e^{-i(g0-g3)t} on the odd block.
equations.justification: Direct algebra: XX+YY = 2(|01><10|+|10><01|) up to sign, so on the odd block it acts as 2X; hence the coupling coefficient is 2(g4+g5) if XX+YY is interpreted as X0X1+Y0Y1 with g4=g5, and the exact value should be recomputed from the matrix before implementation. The qubit-label convention for Z0 and Z1 must be fixed.
assumptions: Little-endian: qubit 0 is the least significant bit of the state label
Recompute the odd-block matrix numerically rather than trusting the closed form

equations.label: Phase encoding
equations.description: Eigenphase of U relates to energy; t and E_ref are chosen so the mapping is unambiguous over the spectrum
equations.justification: Standard PEA relation. Global phase of U becomes relative phase only via the controlled version, so the offset E_ref can be included as a phase gate on the ancilla control.
assumptions: Spectrum fits in a window of width less than 2\pi/t
Controlled-U implemented with the E_ref phase included as a phase gate on the control

equations.label: Iterative feedback and bit extraction
equations.description: Round k applies H on ancilla, controlled-U^{2^{k-1}}, phase feedback from previously measured less significant bits, H, then measure. Rounds run from k=m down to 1, so the least significant bit is measured first.
equations.justification: Kitaev/Dorner iterative PEA. The exact sign convention must be validated by simulation; if \varphi is exactly m-bit representable the outcome is deterministic.
assumptions: Eigenstate prepared exactly, or sufficient overlap with repetition

equations.label: Energy readout
equations.description: Energy from the measured bits with resolution set by m
equations.abstract_quote: we report an energy uncertainty (given our model basis) of the order of $10^{-14}$ Hartree
equations.justification: The small uncertainty is attributed to digital phase resolution in this inferred iterative-PEA reading; the abstract does not state the algorithm. 1e-14 Hartree would need roughly 2^-m*2π/t below 1e-14, i.e. m around 45 bits, which is far beyond a small simulation.
assumptions: The method is iterative PEA (inferred, unconfirmed)

registers.name: anc
registers.role: Reused ancilla (NV electron spin), measured and reset each round

registers.name: sys
registers.role: System qubits (nuclear spins) holding the reduced molecular state

registers.name: c
registers.role: Measured phase bits b_k; the first measured is the least significant

specification.initial_state: |0>_anc ⊗ HF state on sys, X applied to the appropriate qubit to make |01> (or |10>), in the little-endian convention, with the Hartree-Fock determinant parity assumed to lie in the odd-parity block

steps.description: Classically compute g_0..g_5 for chosen R, choose t and E_ref so the spectrum fits in one phase window; precompute the exact 4x4 matrix and eigenvalues for comparison.
Prepare the Hartree-Fock state on the system qubits with X gates.

For k=m down to 1: reset ancilla, H on ancilla, controlled-U^{2^{k-1}} (exact compile, or one query to the black box per round if so supplied), phase feedback Rz/P with angle theta_k computed from earlier bits, H, measure ancilla into bit b_k.
Classically assemble phi from the bits and compute E; compare with exact diagonalization; repeat for each R.

specification.measurement: Measure the ancilla only, once per round, into classical bit for b_k; system qubits are not measured. With Qiskit little-endian counts the last character is classical bit 0, so assign each b_k a defined clbit index and reverse carefully.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Compute phi=sum b_k 2^-k, E=E_ref-2*pi*phi/t, repeat shots to reduce overlap error and pick the lowest consistent outcome, compare to the smallest eigenvalue of the 4x4 H.
assumptions: Minimal-basis 2-qubit reduction with a specific mapping
Hartree-Fock overlap with ground state is nonzero
t and E_ref chosen to avoid aliasing
Mid-circuit measurement and reset with classical feedback is available
The iterative PEA identification is inferred from the abstract, not stated
